Theorem
[Topping] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0185 ↗ ex:chow-iii-topping-incomplete-solution 1. ch21:21.7\group Completeness is essential

There are counterexamples to Theorem 1 if completeness of the evolving solution is omitted. Indeed, choose $x_0=(0,0)$, $r_0=1/2$, and let $r\to 0$ so that $T^r< (\epsilon _0r_0)^2$; the claimed estimate would uniformly bound the curvature up to extinction, contradicting $\inf R_{g_{\mathcal M}^r(t)}\to \infty $.
